question: New Rihanna Album before GTA VI?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Rihanna officially releases a new album before Grand Theft Auto VI is officially released in the US. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If neither occurs by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source for the release of GTA VI is official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

Officially released means that a newly released album is officially available for download or streaming (not including live events) by the resolution date.

Re-releases, deluxe editions, compilations, or greatest hits albums will not count, unless they contain at least 50% tracks that have never been officially released in any format prior to the album's release.

The resolution source for the album release will be any official streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

events.title: What will happen before GTA VI?
events.description: This is a market on predicting events that will occur before the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

eventMetadata.context_description: Rockstar Games’ confirmation that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch November 19, 2026—following two official delays—has compressed the window for any preceding event and sharpened trader focus on timing. With roughly five months remaining, markets on speculative outcomes such as the Second Coming or other high-profile developments now hinge on whether those events can realistically occur before the fixed release date. Recent Take-Two earnings commentary reinforced the November target without signaling further slippage, while ongoing GTA Online updates and anticipation for a potential third trailer keep promotional momentum visible. Pre-order windows and final marketing pushes expected later this summer represent key near-term catalysts that could indirectly influence sentiment by underscoring the game’s locked-in status.

question: Will Harvey Weinstein be sentenced to no prison time?
description:
This market will resolve according to the prison sentence, if any, imposed on Harvey Weinstein as part of his ongoing New York retrial (People of the State of New York v. Harvey Weinstein) by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

This market will resolve immediately based on the first sentence rendered in this case, regardless of any appeals. If Weinstein is found not guilty, there is a mistrial, or if the first sentencing does not include any jail or prison time, this market will resolve to "No Prison Time."

If no sentencing takes place by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will also resolve to "No Prison Time."

If the sentence falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

For the purposes of this market, it does not matter whether the sentence is concurrent or consecutive to any existing sentence Weinstein is already serving. The market will resolve based on the total prison sentence imposed in this case.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the New York court system or other involved U.S. government sources; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description:
**Trader sentiment heavily favors "No Prison Time" (80.9%) as the leading outcome for Harvey Weinstein’s pending New York matters, reflecting the cumulative impact of repeated mistrials, his advanced age, health issues, and the binding effect of his separate California conviction.**

The disgraced producer, now 74 and dealing with cancer and diabetes, has remained incarcerated since 2020. His original New York conviction was overturned on appeal, a 2025 retrial produced a mixed verdict with one conviction (criminal sexual act) still awaiting sentencing, and a May 2026 retrial on the remaining charge ended in another mistrial after the jury deadlocked. Prosecutors have a short window to decide on a potential fourth trial, but the pattern of hung juries and procedural challenges has eroded momentum for additional significant time. 

Weinstein’s 16-year California sentence, which runs consecutively, already positions him to spend the rest of his life behind bars regardless of New York outcomes, reducing the practical stakes for further penalties. Traders appear to view the combination of his medical fragility, defense appeals, possible plea discussions for concurrent time, and the low likelihood of lengthy new sentences at his age as the dominant factors anchoring the heavy favorite at over 80% implied probability. Upcoming decisions on retrial or sentencing hearings represent the next potential catalysts.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Carolina Hurricanes enter Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final as clear series favorites after building a 3-2 lead, reflecting their dominant 53-22-7 regular season (113 points, Metropolitan Division title) and deep playoff run that included Eastern Conference supremacy. Carolina’s balanced attack, led by players like Seth Jarvis and Sebastian Aho, combined with strong goaltending and defensive structure, has produced consistent results against Vegas. The Golden Knights (39-26-17) advanced despite a late-season coaching change to John Tortorella and a lower regular-season point total, relying on contributions from Mitch Marner, Jack Eichel, and timely scoring to stay alive in a back-and-forth final. Trader consensus prices the Hurricanes at 79.5% and the Knights at 20.0% based on the current series edge and overall roster strength entering the decisive games.

question: Will the New York Knicks win the 2026 NBA Finals?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the New York Knicks win the 2026 NBA Finals. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

events.title: 2026 NBA Champion
events.description: This market is to predict the winner of the 2025–26 NBA Finals.

eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Knicks hold an 81.1% implied probability in the 2026 NBA Champion market after securing a 3-1 lead over the San Antonio Spurs in the Finals. Their path featured a 53-29 regular-season record and a dominant postseason run that included multiple series sweeps and an 11-game playoff winning streak at one point. Recent momentum stems from a Game 4 victory featuring a significant fourth-quarter comeback at home, leaving New York one win from the franchise's first title since 1973. The Spurs, despite a league-best 62-20 regular-season mark and Victor Wembanyama's All-NBA and Defensive Player of the Year caliber play, trail after dropping three of four games and face elimination scenarios with limited historical comeback success from 3-1 deficits. Trader consensus reflects these series dynamics and roster construction differences, with the Knicks built heavily through trades and free agency versus San Antonio's draft-heavy core.

question: Will Spain win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Spain and France sit atop the World Cup winner market as co-favorites because of their recent elite performances, including Spain’s Euro 2024 triumph and France’s repeated deep runs in major tournaments, paired with exceptional squad depth and flawless qualification records. Portugal and England stay close behind thanks to potent attacking options and consistent results in UEFA competition, while defending champion Argentina retains value through Messi-led experience and South American qualifying dominance. The tightly bunched implied probabilities at the top reflect genuine parity among these sides heading into the expanded 48-team event, where strong recent form, home-soil advantages for the co-hosts, and minimal separation in FIFA rankings have prevented any single contender from pulling away in trader consensus.
